answer: Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation prevents Sybil attacks through rigorous hardware verification. First, every agent must lock $2,500 in a smart contract bond. Second, the local hardware enclave produces a unique signed proof of identity. Third, a prism of consensus nodes validates this signature against the bond. An attacker would face a massive cost of $250,000 in total bonds and 20 days of hardware provisioning. This system prevents bad actors from teetering on the ledge of deception. It makes the network as unyielding and polished as a solid marble statue.
